verdict.rationale: Authy has a developer API and SDK, so asking whether it can issue scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents nothing of the kind: no scoped keys, restricted tokens or per-agent permissions. Twilio's docs also say the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for deprecation. Its device and 2FA token controls are end-user authenticator features, not credential scoping for programmatic consumers, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
